text: Has a lot of functions that I was looking for but unfortunately the app is not very user friendly. It took me a long time to figure out all the details. I think this could be easier. Further: the statistics are not correct. When I choose to show the statistics for a day it says that the intended time for ’sleeping’ is 2 days. I only entered 8 hours. When I look at ’working’ it says 1 day but there is only 4 hours on the planner. How do I solve this? (Both tasks are intents for multiple days.) A
author: Een Google-gebruiker
developer_reply:
Roselien, yes, it's not the simplest app ever. Still, I'm glad you've figured out how you can make it work for you.
Please go to Settings->General->Working day hours (turn it off). This way you avoid measuring a day as 8 hours, as you have for now, your stats will be corrected. Most people plan job tasks only, thus need this option.
